notes.title: DEMO content update & bug fix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Based on the feedback i receive i made some changes to how the player interact with the basement computer, made the fuse pickupable straight away, added a bit of lore items, now there is an additional environment before going in the cyber world. It's a the inside of unit 199 where you plug yourself into the cyber world.

I also did some optimization and small bug fixes.

notes.title: Name Change Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I recently discovered that our game’s title, Synthetic Souls, is very similar to an existing adult game. Not exactly the association i was going for! ːsteamsadː

To avoid confusion (and awkward search results), i decided to rebrand the anthology series under a new name:
[b]DREADCORE [/b]

DreadCore will continue to be the same cyberpunk horror anthology you've been excited about exploring psychological horror, technology, and the consequences of digital immortality. The first episode, Locked Unit, is still on track and will be your first dive into this unsettling world.

Thanks for your support and understanding! I think DreadCore fits even better and can’t wait to share more soon.

Stay tuned for more updates.
